title: Comedy versus music, and bass solos in the 1930s
summary: Stewart insists he was serious about his music; he was already featured as a bowed and humming soloist before meeting Slim.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, you -- now, that duo became pretty famous. Sometimes it seems at this point that people had tended to put more emphasis on the comedy than on the music. Now, how did you feel about it at that time? Did you see it as a light thing, or did you see it as something that you were still very serious about, your music with him?

Yes, I was very serious about my music, you know, and as a matter of fact, I did quite a bit of bowing and humming along with our act, you know. And I, as time went on, you know, I was still searching for better sounds with my solos and, you know.
Were basses playing many solos in those days?
Well, yes, they were playing pizzicato solos.
In the '30s?
Yeah, they were playing like Jimmy Blanton.
Well now, he came in like --
He came a little later, but then --
-- I mean people like you got John Kerr --
John Kirby. Braud
-- and and was it Walter Page --
COTTON CONTENT
Walter Page, yeah. Every once in a while they had the little short solos and pizzicato (inaudible).
You mean like a chorus or half chorus or maybe a bridge or something?
A half a chorus or a chorus.
Huh. Now, but you tended to play more to -- or did you or did you not play more solos than people -- I'm talking about just before you got with Gailand --
Yeah, Slim,
-- were you playing a lot of solos before then in the band?
Yes, oh, yes, I was.
So then like the band leaders that you've got to recognize that it was a certain, that it was an attractive thing to the listener --
Yes, that's right.
-- for what you were playing.
I was featured quite a bit, yes, before I even met Slim, yes.
Now, were you, now, were most of -- were you featured both pizzicato and arco and humming or were you featured almost exclusively arco and humming?
Almost -- only arco and humming.
